ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for being a longtime Weber fan! We are sorry to hear that you have uneven heat throughout your grill. We suggest allowing your grill to preheat for 15 minutes with the lid closed before you begin to grill. This will allow the heat from the grilling surface area to even itself out. This might be the trick that can help! Be sure to keep the burner tubes cleaned and unclog any ports if needed. If you continue to experience this issue, don't hesitate to get in touch with us. We are happy to help! Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I bought this E-210 about 2 months ago and have used it 6 for 7 times now. It's very well built and well thought out but it heats very(!) unevenly. Things in the back will literally burn while the things in the front are barely brown. At first I thought maybe my burners were defective or something but they appear to be working correctly. I understand hotspots and having to rotate things while grilling but this one has extremely uneven hot spots. The grill this one replaced was a 9 or 10 year old Weber E3200 which cooked much more evenly.
Results.Title: Great quality, below average performance.

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber gas grill…my first was a Genesis II that I lost in my divorce! Both were really good with even heating but the compactness of the Spirit II is wonderful for me and my two children. I can honestly say that I am a Weber fan for life!
Results.Title: Quality and perfection throughout!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill has excellent burners and clever mechanisms for directing grease out of the burner area. It is also compact, lightweight and has more grill area with two burners than the 20 year old 4 burner Kenmore Elite grill it replaces. It works great but I worry about longevity. The tires seem chintzy and have no inner sidewalls. They are like tires for a toy, not an appliance, they have no inner sidewalls and there are only two of them. One must lift the other end to move the grill. It's not a big deal but I wonder what shape they will be in in 5-10 years. Also the little hub caps keep being popped off by the  axle sliding back and forth. I had the opportunity to disassemble my old grill and was surprised to see that all the fasteners were bright and shiny because they were made of stainless steel. The fasteners for this grill seem to be made of some kind of plastic which should be corrosion resistant but I wonder if they are going to get brittle after a few years of seasonal changes. Short version: I am extremely happy with the grill right now but worry that it will need to be replaced prematurely.
Results.Title: Modern Technology for Better or Worse?

Results.ReviewText:
The grill is awesome. Have many great delicious meals cooked on our Spirit . 
Only reason for the 4 stars I the flavor bars rusted quickly and was amazed at how the cooking crates had begun to rust. We clean our grill per Weber directions -nothing  to do with excess corrosion of built up grease. 
We contacted Weber and provided CS with pictures model number and proof of purchase. They honored their warranty.
New grates abd flavor bars were out of stock…so we are still awaiting flavor bars. Grates arrived in approximately 3 wks from CS call. 

We look forward to many more grilled  meals

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
